in_hebrew.name: Huntley
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Huntley הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘hunta’ (hunter) and ‘leah’ (clearing). The name Huntley may have originally referred to a place where hunters gathered. It is now a popular name for boys in the English-speaking world.
